_comment: The report-it-right router. Front doors only: organisation names, long-stable national numbers, and top-level URLs that won't rot. Deep links to specific council forms go stale — add them only if you're prepared to re-check them. NAC deep links worth adding later: their 'report it' landing page, planning portal search.

routes.problem: Missed bin, or a new bin
Pothole or street light — town streets
routes.route: North Ayrshire Council — roads. They maintain every street in Largs except the A78.
The A78 is a trunk road — Transport Scotland's contractors, not NAC. Report it through Traffic Scotland.

routes.problem: Water leak, burst pipe, no supply

routes.route: Call 105 — free, from any phone, whoever your supplier is.
National gas emergency line, 24 hours. Call before anything else.
CalMac's own status page is the live word on the Cumbrae crossing.
National Rail carries ScotRail's live running.
North Ayrshire Council's planning portal — comments go on the file, where they count.
101 for anything that doesn't need blue lights. An emergency is always 999.
